idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness WebUI
idea-plugin.description:
Docks the DeepSeek Harness Web UI into a JetBrains IDE tool window, rendered by the IDE's bundled Chromium (JCEF). The full WebUI — reasoning streams, tool-call trajectory, sessions, permission/preset switching — lives inside the IDE, hideable like the terminal.

Features

  • DeepSeek Harness Web UI docked as a standard IDE tool window
  • Reload the page without restarting the IDE — header button or gear menu Reload Page (hard reload, browser cache bypassed)
  • Theme-aware tool window icon (light/dark)

Requires the official DeepSeek Harness with web support running locally (npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web), served at http://127.0.0.1:3080 by default (configurable via the dsh.web.url JVM property).
